The structure of Lu3In3Sb6 (reduced formula LuInSb2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements in tetrahedral environments with four geometric neighbors per center atom, at uniform neighbor distances of 2.9419 Å. In and Lu each coordinate to four Sb neighbors, while each Sb center coordinates to two In and two Lu neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between In tetrahedra and between Lu tetrahedra, as well as edge-sharing between In and Lu tetrahedra.
